programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Cardinals (7-4) and Wildcats (5-6) compete for The Governor's Cup. Kentucky leads the series 20-16 after Louisville snapped a five-game series slide with a 41-14 victory last season The Wildcats have won three of their past four contests.

programs.title: CFP Semifinal at the VRBO Fiesta Bowl
programs.desc: No. 6 Ole Miss faces No. 10 Miami in the Fiesta Bowl at State Farm Stadium for a spot in the College Football Playoff semifinals. The Rebels seek an eighth straight win behind Kewan Lacy (23 TDs), while the Hurricanes lean on QB Carson Beck (27 TDs).

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 12 Tigers seek a 10th straight win over the Yellow Jackets in this match from Bobby Dodd Stadium. Clemson doubled up Georgia Tech 42-21 behind four TD passes from Cade Klubnik on Nov. 11, 2023. Georgia Tech leads the all-time series 51-36-2.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Tigers (3-4, 2-3 ACC) and Blue Devils (4-3, 3-1) return from the bye. In 2023, Duke snapped a five-game series slide with its first victory over Clemson since 2004. Duke's three-game win streak was snapped by undefeated Georgia Tech on Oct. 18.

programs.title: CFP Quarterfinal at the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic
programs.desc: The No. 10 Miami Hurricanes face the No. 2 Ohio State Buckeyes at AT&T Stadium. This is a high-stakes College Football Playoff Quarterfinal matchup. Miami advanced after a gritty 10-3 road upset over No. 7 Texas A&M in the CFP First Round.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Seminoles (4-4, 1-4 ACC) look to take advantage of the reeling Tigers (3-5, 2-4). Clemson has dropped two in a row, including its first home loss to Duke since 1980. Florida State snapped a four-game league slide by demolishing Wake Forest 42-7.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Cardinals (4-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against a tough foe in the No. 2 Hurricanes (5-0, 1-0). Louisville dropped its first game of the season in a 30-27 overtime decision versus Virginia on Oct. 4. Miami defeated Louisville 52-45 last year.
